data.name: Ajawid
data.gender_notes: Ajawid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'Ajada' meaning to devote or be devoted. This name holds deep spiritual significance as it refers to a person who is deeply committed to their faith. The name Ajawid carries the meaning “Devoted, Religious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ajawid usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted, religious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
